payload.body_you: Saturn in Aries can make every financial decision feel urgent. Buy it now. Quit now. Take the first offer. Spend because waiting feels like powerlessness. Let the first rush pass. The purchase, job, or goal you still want after the mood changes is the one worth funding.
payload.body_they: Saturn in Aries can make every financial decision feel urgent to them: buy it now, quit now, take the first offer. The purchase, job, or goal they still want after the mood changes is the one worth funding.

ownerConfirmationStatement: the writing that was being shown in the natal chart was approved
